item.question: What is the purpose of Partial Experts Checkpointing (PEC) in MoE model training?
item.answer: The purpose of Partial Experts Checkpointing (PEC) is to significantly downsize the checkpoint size by saving a subset of experts while preserving non-expert parts in their entirety.
